shortBio.en: Black Sabbath's original howl—then a solo brand that outlived one lineup version.
shortBio.zh: Black Sabbath 的原始嚎叫——随后独奏品牌活过某一个阵容版本。

whyHub.en: The cleanest textbook of band → solo flow: fired from the founding Metal lineup, then bigger alone.
whyHub.zh: 乐队→独奏流动的教科书：被金属创始阵容开除，随后独奏更大。

body.en: Ozzy makes lineup versions visceral. Sabbath's Ozzy-era peak is one object; the Dio-era Sabbath is another; Ozzy solo is a third career graph. Person pages exist so that story is not smashed into a single band blob.
body.zh: Ozzy 让阵容版本变得可感。Sabbath 的 Ozzy 时期是一个对象；Dio 时期是另一个；Ozzy 独奏是第三张履历图。人物页存在，就是为了别把故事揉进一个乐队团块。
